## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(qs)
library(ewastools)
library(grid)
library(here)
library(writexl)
```

## READ IN METHYLATION & PHENOTYPE DATA

### (Merge) (working directory: /home/kanney/EWAS_Aim1)

```{r}
# Load in the DNAm data
beta <- qread("HRS_BMIQ_filtered.qs")
dim(beta)

# Load complete analytic dataset file from 01_DataManage_Exclusion.qmd
pheno <- readRDS("Jan162026-Updates/HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset20261601.RDS") 

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(pheno, file = "Jan162026-Updates/pheno.RDS")

gc()
```

## DNAm data cleaning (match to HHIDPN)

```{r}
# Ensure that the sample IDs match between beta and pheno
sample_ids = colnames(beta)
length(sample_ids) # 3980
pheno_subset = pheno %>% filter(Basename %in% sample_ids)
dim(pheno_subset) # dim = (3558,28)

# Reorder the columns of beta to match the order of sample IDs in pheno_subset
beta_test_ordered = beta[, pheno_subset$Basename]

# Verify that sample IDs are in the same order
if (!all(colnames(beta_test_ordered) == pheno_subset$Basename)) {
  stop("Sample IDs in beta_test and pheno_subset do not match.")
}
```

## Set-up Covariates for EWAS Models

### M1/Health Only (h_exposure): DNAm \~ age + sex + race/ethnicity + adult health variables + GR + NK + B + CD4 + CD8 + plate

```{r}
covariates_childruralh = c('childrural_democoggen', 'age', 'sex', 'raceethnicity_collapsed', 'HIBP_latest', 'DIAB_latest', 'VIGACT_collapsed', 'Sample_Plate', 'GR', 'NK', 'B', 'CD4', 'CD8')
covariates_schlyrsh = c('SCHLYRS_rev', 'age', 'sex', 'raceethnicity_collapsed', 'HIBP_latest', 'DIAB_latest', 'VIGACT_collapsed', 'Sample_Plate', 'GR', 'NK', 'B', 'CD4', 'CD8')
covariates_livegparh = c('LIVEGPAR_R', 'age', 'sex', 'raceethnicity_collapsed', 'HIBP_latest', 'DIAB_latest', 'VIGACT_collapsed', 'Sample_Plate', 'GR', 'NK', 'B', 'CD4', 'CD8')
covariates_chsmkh = c('CHSMOKE_R', 'age', 'sex', 'raceethnicity_collapsed', 'HIBP_latest', 'DIAB_latest', 'VIGACT_collapsed', 'Sample_Plate', 'GR', 'NK', 'B', 'CD4', 'CD8')
```

```{r}
covar_livegpar_ds2 = c('LIVEGPAR_R', 'age', 'sex', 'raceethnicity_collapsed', 'ATOTB_latest', 'smoke_latest', 'HIBP_latest', 'DIAB_latest', 'VIGACT_collapsed', 'Sample_Plate', 'GR', 'NK', 'B', 'CD4', 'CD8')
```

## Create the design matrix

### M1/Health Only (h_exposure): DNAm \~ age + sex + race/ethnicity + adult health variables + GR + NK + B + CD4 + CD8 + plate

```{r}
design_formula_h = as.formula(paste("~", paste(covariates_childruralh, collapse = " + ")))
design_matrix_h = model.matrix(design_formula_h, data = pheno_subset)
dim(design_matrix_h) # dim = (3558, 63)

design_formula2_h = as.formula(paste("~", paste(covariates_schlyrsh, collapse = " + ")))
design_matrix2_h = model.matrix(design_formula2_h, data = pheno_subset)
dim(design_matrix2_h) 

design_formula3_h = as.formula(paste("~", paste(covariates_livegparh, collapse = " + ")))
design_matrix3_h = model.matrix(design_formula3_h, data = pheno_subset)
dim(design_matrix3_h)

design_formula4_h = as.formula(paste("~", paste(covariates_chsmkh, collapse = " + ")))
design_matrix4_h = model.matrix(design_formula4_h, data = pheno_subset)
dim(design_matrix4_h) 
```

### M3/Primary (rural_smk_8, schlyrs_m3, livegpar_smk_10, chsmk_ds): DNAm \~ age + sex + race/ethnicity + adult smoking + socioeconomic and behavior variable + adult health variables + GR + NK + B + CD4 + CD8 + plate

```{r}
design_formula_ds8 = as.formula(paste("~", paste(covar_rural_ds2, collapse = " + ")))
```

## Run EWAS analysis

```{r}
library(limma)

# Fit the linear models using limma
beta_matrix = as.matrix(beta_test_ordered)

# Fit M1/Health Only 
fit_h = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix_h)
fit_h = eBayes(fit_h)

fit2_h = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix2_h)
fit2_h = eBayes(fit2_h)

fit3_h = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix3_h)
fit3_h = eBayes(fit3_h)

fit4_h = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix4_h)
fit4_h = eBayes(fit4_h)


# Fit M2/Health, socioeconomic, and behavior Variables
fit_h2 = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix_h2)
fit_h2 = eBayes(fit_h2)

fit2_h2 = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix2_h2)
fit2_h2 = eBayes(fit2_h2)

fit3_h2 = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix3_h2)
fit3_h2 = eBayes(fit3_h2)

fit4_h2 = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix4_h2)
fit4_h2 = eBayes(fit4_h2)


#Fit M3/Primary
fit_ds8 = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix_ds8)
fit_ds8 = eBayes(fit_ds8)

fit_ds9 = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix_ds9)
fit_ds9 = eBayes(fit_ds9)

fit_ds10 = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix_ds10)
fit_ds10 = eBayes(fit_ds10)

fit_ds4 = lmFit(beta_matrix, design_matrix_ds4)
fit_ds4 = eBayes(fit_ds4)
```

## EXTRACT EWAS MODEL RESULTS

### M1/Health Only (h_exposure): DNAm \~ age + sex + race/ethnicity + adult health variables + GR + NK + B + CD4 + CD8 + plate

```{r}
childrural_col_h = which(colnames(design_matrix_h) == 'childrural_democoggenYes')
results_rural_h = topTable(fit_h, coef = childrural_col_h, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
head(results_rural_h)

schlyrs_col_h = which(colnames(design_matrix2_h) == 'SCHLYRS_rev')
results_schlyrs_h = topTable(fit2_h, coef = schlyrs_col_h, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
head(results_schlyrs_h)

livegpar_col_h = which(colnames(design_matrix3_h) == 'LIVEGPAR_RYes')
results_livegpar_h = topTable(fit3_h, coef = livegpar_col_h, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
head(results_livegpar_h)

chsmk_col_h = which(colnames(design_matrix4_h) == 'CHSMOKE_RYes')
results_chsmk_h = topTable(fit4_h, coef = chsmk_col_h, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
head(results_chsmk_h)
```

### M3/Primary (rural_smk_8, schlyrs_m3, livegpar_smk_10, chsmk_ds): DNAm \~ age + sex + race/ethnicity + adult smoking + socioeconomic and behavior variable + adult health variables + GR + NK + B + CD4 + CD8 + plate

## ANNOTATE AND EXPORT MODEL RESULTS

```{r}
# Reset the row names as a column for merging
  ## M1/Health Only
results_rural_h = results_rural_h %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_rural_h))

results_schlyrs_h = results_schlyrs_h %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_schlyrs_h))

results_livegpar_h = results_livegpar_h %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_livegpar_h))

results_chsmk_h = results_chsmk_h %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_chsmk_h))

  ## M2/Health, socioeconomic, and behavior Variables
results_rural_h2 = results_rural_h2 %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_rural_h2))

results_schlyrs_h2 = results_schlyrs_h2 %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_schlyrs_h2))

results_livegpar_h2 = results_livegpar_h2 %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_livegpar_h2))

results_chsmk_h2 = results_chsmk_h2 %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_chsmk_h2))

  ## M3/Primary
results_rural_ds8 = results_rural_ds8 %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_rural_ds8))

results_schlyrs_ds9 = results_schlyrs_ds9 %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_schlyrs_ds9))

results_livegpar_ds10 = results_livegpar_ds10 %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_livegpar_ds10))

results_chsmk_ds = results_chsmk_ds %>% mutate(CpG = rownames(results_chsmk_ds))


# Load annotation data for the CpG sites
  ## For EPIC array annotation
if (!requireNamespace("IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19")
}
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
annotation = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)

# Bind results with annotation
annotation_df = data.frame(
  CpG = annotation$Name,
  CHR = annotation$chr,
  BP = annotation$pos,
  UCSC_RefGene_Name = annotation$UCSC_RefGene_Name,
  UCSC_RefGene_Group = annotation$UCSC_RefGene_Group,
  Relation_to_Island = annotation$Relation_to_Island
)
# Clean up chromosome names (remove 'chr' prefix)
annotation_df$CHR = gsub("chr", "", annotation_df$CHR)

# Convert sex chromosomes to numeric values or exclude them
  ## Convert 'X' and 'Y' to 23 and 24
annotation_df$CHR[annotation_df$CHR == "X"] = "23"
annotation_df$CHR[annotation_df$CHR == "Y"] = "24"

  ## Convert chromosome column to numeric
dim(annotation_df)  #865859      6
annotation_df$CHR = as.numeric(annotation_df$CHR)

  ## Remove CpGs with non-numeric chromosomes (e.g., mitochondrial DNA)
annotation_df = annotation_df %>% filter(!is.na(CHR))
dim(annotation_df)  #865859      6
```
